A22 phase 2: enqueues an `import` job that calls `confirm_import`, then (job flow, P2-C
plan section) enqueues a `classify` job for the transactions it inserted.

get.description:
One page of transactions. `include_candidates` adds each row's per-layer suggestions
(`candidates`) and `conflict`; `include_conflict` adds just the `conflict` flag (the grid's
marker). Both are batch-computed for this page only. `conflict=true|false` (a filter)
narrows the whole result set to rows with, or without, conflicting suggestions.

Ids of *every* transaction matching the same filters as `GET /transactions` (no page
cap), for "select all N matching" in the grid.

What each classification layer (your rules, built-in rules, the issuer's label, the learned
cache / saved LLM answer) would say about this transaction, highest priority first, and
whether they disagree. Read-only; never calls the LLM. Click-to-apply is `PATCH
/transactions/{id}` with the chosen category.

post.description:
Drop this transaction's one-time edit and re-run the deterministic cascade for it (your
rules, built-in rules, the issuer's label, the learned cache; uncategorized and flagged for
review if none answers). Never calls the LLM. 409 if the row is not currently edited by hand.
The undo token goes to `POST /review/undo` to restore the edit.

`revert-to-automatic` for many rows. Rows that are not edited by hand, or no longer exist,
are skipped and counted; the rest go back to automatic classification (no LLM call).

Apply one label and/or kind to `transaction_ids`. `updated` counts only rows actually
changed: ids that no longer exist, and a request with nothing to apply, count for nothing —
compare it with `len(transaction_ids)` to spot a partial update.

Reverse one accept (or one rule application) from its undo token. `restored` is how many
transactions went back; `skipped` lists the ones left alone because they changed afterwards,
and `rule_skipped` says the accept's rule was left alone for the same reason.

get.description: The exact CSV the next run would send (A5), decoded back into rows. No network call.

schema.title: Response List Rules Api Rules Get

get.description:
What applying a user rule to existing transactions would change right now (nothing is
changed): how many rows, how many users own them, how many would get a different kind. A rule
with no owner applies across every user's transactions.

post.description:
Apply a user rule to the transactions that already exist (rules otherwise only affect
future classification). Never overwrites a hand-corrected transaction or one a
higher-priority rule claims; `updated` is how many rows changed. `undo` is a token for
`POST /review/undo` that puts those rows back (rows edited since are skipped).

put.description:
Save the draft to `config.toml`. Settings an environment variable (`PFA_<SECTION>__<FIELD>`)
controls are not written: the file keeps its own value for them (so a one-off override never
becomes permanent), and the response lists them in `env_overrides` with the effective values.

Store `body.api_key` for the endpoint's host in the OS keychain (I7), or, only when there is
no keychain and the user enabled `[secrets] allow_file_store`, in the 0600 file store. Never
returned, logged, or written to `config.toml`/the database. `503` (with an actionable message)
when no backend can take it.

delete.description: Remove the key stored for the endpoint's host, if present (I7). Idempotent.

get.description:
Which backend holds the LLM API key (environment variable / keychain name / plaintext file
/ none), with platform-specific setup advice when no keychain works. Read-only; never returns
a key. `base_url` (default: the saved one) picks the endpoint whose key is looked up.

The key saved under the pre-rename keychain service is only looked for with
`check_legacy=true` (the Settings screen's explicit "check" button): reading an entry another
build of the app saved can make macOS ask the user to allow it, which a page load must not
trigger.

put.description:
Switch the plaintext file store on or off (`[secrets] allow_file_store`; only used when the
OS keychain is unavailable). `409` while an environment variable controls the opt-in: it wins
on every load, so the toggle could not change anything.

Switching it off does not leave a plaintext key behind unnoticed: a key still in the file is
moved into the OS keychain when one works, otherwise the caller must choose
(`file_key_action`) to delete the file (overwritten, then removed) or to keep it. The response
says which happened (`file_key_outcome`), so the UI can state where the key now lives.

post.description:
Apply personal-info entries (the unsaved draft in `body.terms`, else the saved
`[privacy] pii_terms`) to a pasted sample. Pure and local: nothing is sent anywhere, stored or
logged, and the entries are never echoed back.

One-row round trip via the same `classify_batch` egress path every real classification
uses. Tests the unsaved draft in `body.llm` when given, else the saved settings.

get.description:
Export the transactions matching `filters` (the same filters as `GET /transactions`;
unfiltered, everything), oldest first. `user_id` is shorthand for `user_ids=[user_id]`: the
CLI's `export --user-id`/`--all-users` call this directly with a resolved id or `None`. The
CLI passes `filters=crud.TransactionFilters(currency=None, include_non_spend=True)`.

failing the list; it can be renamed, repaired by saving new parameters, or deleted.

Rename and/or replace the parameters. A preset whose stored parameters are invalid can be
renamed (the response is then the name-only `InvalidForecastPreset`) or repaired by sending
new `params`. `user_id` is the viewing user, as for the list: another user's preset is 404.

AcceptUndo.title: AcceptUndo
AcceptUndo.description:
Opaque undo token for one Review accept or one "apply rule to existing" (everything it
changed): each patched transaction before and after and, for an "always categorize" accept,
the merchant's rule. Held by the client and validated on use.

ApiKeyPut.title: ApiKeyPut
ApiKeyPut.description:
`PUT /api/settings/api-key` body (I7: the key is written straight to the OS keychain via
`config.set_api_key` — never to `config.toml`, the database, a response, or a log line).
The key is stored for `base_url`'s host (default: the saved `[llm] base_url`), so it is only
ever sent to that host.

BackupExportRequest.title: BackupExportRequest
BackupExportRequest.description:
`passphrase` encrypts the archive (at least 8 characters). Sending no passphrase is only
accepted with an explicit `encrypt: false`.

BulkRevertResponse.title: BulkRevertResponse
BulkRevertResponse.description:
`reverted` rows had an edit and went back to automatic; `skipped` were not edited by hand
(or no longer exist) and are untouched. `undo` restores every reverted row.

BulkUpdateRequest.title: BulkUpdateRequest
BulkUpdateRequest.description: Edit every listed transaction one time each (no rule, no merchant memory).

ForecastDefaults.title: ForecastDefaults
ForecastDefaults.description:
Values suggested from history; each is None when the data does not support it.

Each level is as of its own `*_year`, and the years can differ; the screen rebases income and
spending to the chosen starting year.

ForecastParams.title: ForecastParams
ForecastParams.description: One forecast scenario. A None starting value means "use the figure derived from history".

ForecastPresetUpdate.title: ForecastPresetUpdate
ForecastPresetUpdate.description: Rename and/or replace the parameters; omitted fields are left as they are.

InvalidForecastPreset.title: InvalidForecastPreset
InvalidForecastPreset.description: A saved preset whose stored parameters no longer validate: only identity is returned.

IssuerConflictResponse.title: IssuerConflictResponse
IssuerConflictResponse.description:
The 409 body for an issuer create/rename that collides with an existing issuer; mirrors
the layout-spec 422 convention of a structured `detail`.

Kind.title: Kind
Kind.description:
The seven `Kind` values (§3.1), as a real enum rather than a `Literal` alias: FastAPI
only emits a named, reusable `components.schemas.Kind` in the OpenAPI document (which the
frontend's generated client references as `components["schemas"]["Kind"]`) for an enum type
— a `Literal` field is inlined per-field instead.

LlmParsePreview.title: LlmParsePreview
LlmParsePreview.description:
`GET /api/statements/{id}/llm-preview?pages=1,2`: the exact page text (after
redaction) that the LLM statement parser would send, one entry per request. No network.

LlmSettings.title: LlmSettings
LlmSettings.description:
`[llm]` (one endpoint for classification and opt-in statement parsing). `mode`,
`resolved_url` and `has_key` are derived and read-only: ignored on `PUT`.

PiiTestRequest.title: PiiTestRequest
PiiTestRequest.description:
`POST /api/settings/pii-test`: apply personal-info entries to a pasted sample. `terms`
(unsaved draft entries) defaults to the saved `[privacy] pii_terms`. Nothing leaves the
machine and nothing is stored.

RevertToAutomaticResponse.title: RevertToAutomaticResponse
RevertToAutomaticResponse.description:
`POST /transactions/{id}/revert-to-automatic`: the row, handed back to automatic
classification (never an LLM call), and the same undo token an accept carries
(`POST /review/undo` puts the one-time edit back).

RuleApplyPreview.title: RuleApplyPreview
RuleApplyPreview.description: What `POST /rules/{id}/apply` would do right now, for the confirmation step.

RuleSnapshot.title: RuleSnapshot
RuleSnapshot.description: The merchant's exact rule around an accept: `before=None` means the accept created it.

SecretStoragePut.title: SecretStoragePut
SecretStoragePut.description:
`PUT /api/settings/secret-storage`: switch the plaintext file store on or off
(`[secrets] allow_file_store`).

Turning it off (or calling again with it already off) while the key file still holds keys
needs a decision about them, `file_key_action`: `move` them into the OS keychain (the default
when one works), `delete` the file (overwritten, then removed) or `keep` it on disk, unused.
Without a working keychain there is no default: the call is refused with `409` until the
caller chooses `delete` or `keep`, so a key never stays on disk by accident.

SecretStorageStatus.title: SecretStorageStatus
SecretStorageStatus.description:
`GET /api/settings/secret-storage`: which secret backend holds (or would hold) the LLM API
key on this machine. Never contains key material.

StatementPageInfo.title: StatementPageInfo
StatementPageInfo.description:
`GET /api/statements/{id}/pages` row: enough to choose pages without opening the PDF.
A thumbnail is at `GET /api/statements/{id}/pages/{page_number}/image`.

TaxDocumentPatch.title: TaxDocumentPatch
TaxDocumentPatch.description: Reassign a document (with its forms and items) to another user.

TaxEstimateCalc.title: TaxEstimateCalc
TaxEstimateCalc.description:
The computation (the whole household's for a joint return), all `_minor` fields in cents and
the rates as fractions (0.22 = 22%).

TaxEstimateCrossCheck.title: TaxEstimateCrossCheck
TaxEstimateCrossCheck.description:
The latest Form 1040 for the year beside the estimate (never an input). Deltas are
estimate minus return; `null` when the return did not print the figure.

TaxEstimateUser.title: TaxEstimateUser
TaxEstimateUser.description:
This user's part. For `scope` `individual` it equals the computation; for
`household_allocation` `total_tax_minor` is an allocation of the household tax by `share` of
gross income (an allocation, not a separate liability) and the payments are the user's own.

TaxFormType.title: TaxFormType
TaxFormType.description: Mirror of `core.tax_types.FormType` (kept in sync by a test), as a named OpenAPI enum.

TaxHeadline.title: TaxHeadline
TaxHeadline.description:
What to show as the tax paid for the year (minor units). `federal_basis` says where the
federal figure comes from: `return` (the 1040's total tax with the Additional Medicare Tax
counted once, in `fica_minor`), `estimate` (the per-user estimate, no return), `withholding`
(federal tax withheld), or `mixed` (an all-users view whose users differ).

TaxLlmReadRequest.title: TaxLlmReadRequest
TaxLlmReadRequest.description: `POST /api/tax/documents/{id}/llm-fallback`: the pages the user agreed to send.

TaxMemoAmount.title: TaxMemoAmount
TaxMemoAmount.description:
A memo line (not part of total income): `qualified_dividends`, `tax_exempt`, or the W-2 box 12
memos `retirement_deferral` and `hsa_employer`.

TaxParametersRefreshResponse.title: TaxParametersRefreshResponse
TaxParametersRefreshResponse.description:
`POST /api/tax/parameters/refresh`: one update check, run now (an explicit action, so it
does not need the opt-in).

TaxProfileIn.title: TaxProfileIn
TaxProfileIn.description:
`PUT /api/tax/profiles/{user_id}/{tax_year}` body: the manual inputs of the estimate.
Amounts are non-negative cents. `joint_with_user_id` (the spouse, another existing user) is
only valid with `filing_status` `mfj`. A profile describes its own user: with a linked spouse
who has a profile too, the two profiles are added together, so each spouse enters their own
boxes (the estimate limits each to 2 boxes and 1 person aged 65+). A joint profile whose
spouse has no profile of their own carries the household total.
`age65_or_blind_count` counts the boxes checked for the additional standard deduction (age 65
or older, blind): at most 2 per person, 4 for `mfj` (both spouses). `age65_count` is the
number of people aged 65 or older (for the 2025-2028 senior deduction): at most 1, 2 for
`mfj`, and not more than the boxes.

TaxSettings.title: TaxSettings
TaxSettings.description:
`[tax]`: `auto_update_params` is the opt-in once-a-year check for updated federal tax
parameters (a plain GET of one public file, no user data; off by default).

TaxSkippedFrom.title: TaxSkippedFrom
TaxSkippedFrom.description: An earlier document whose form made this upload's form a skipped duplicate.

TaxSourceResponse.title: TaxSourceResponse
TaxSourceResponse.description:
`POST /api/tax/documents/{id}/source`: the re-selected file is the document's original;
it is held temporarily (never kept) so its pages can be shown and read.

TaxSupersededForm.title: TaxSupersededForm
TaxSupersededForm.description: A source form replaced by a corrected form with the same payer and account (not counted).

TestLlmRequest.title: TestLlmRequest
TestLlmRequest.description:
Optional `POST /api/settings/test-llm` body: test these (unsaved, draft) LLM settings
instead of the saved ones. Omit the body to test what is saved.

TransactionCandidate.title: TransactionCandidate
TransactionCandidate.description:
One cascade layer's answer for one transaction. Clicking it is an ordinary one-time edit
(`PATCH /transactions/{id}` with this category, subcategory and `kind` when set).

TransactionCandidates.title: TransactionCandidates
TransactionCandidates.description: `GET /api/transactions/{id}/candidates`: what each layer would say, in precedence order.

TransactionIds.title: TransactionIds
TransactionIds.description: `GET /api/transactions/ids`: every id matching the filters (not one page of them).

TransactionPatch.title: TransactionPatch
TransactionPatch.description:
A one-time edit of one transaction: it changes only that transaction and always wins over
every rule and re-run. Nothing is remembered about the merchant unless `create_rule` is set.

TransactionSnapshot.title: TransactionSnapshot
TransactionSnapshot.description:
One transaction as the operation found it (`before`) and left it (`after`); sent back
unchanged to `POST /review/undo`, which restores `before` only if the row still equals
`after`.

TransactionState.title: TransactionState
TransactionState.description:
The classification fields one accept (or "apply to existing") can change on a
transaction. Values are validated: a token naming an unknown kind or `classified_by` is
rejected.

WatchSettings.title: WatchSettings
WatchSettings.description: `[watch]`: import PDFs put into the documents folder by hand, in the background.
